name.en: MG 1/100 MS-06R-2 Gabby Hazard's Zaku II

ja: 特徴的なカラーリングに、ＭＳＶ特有のマーキングが施された高機動型ザク。 ＭＳＶシリーズの機体、ＭＧで続々キット化！
ギ　ャ　ビ　ー　・　ハ　ザ　ー　ド　中　佐　機　、　戦　場　に　現　る　-------------------
機動戦士ガンダム ＭＳＶより、ＭＳ－０６Ｒ－２ ギャビー・ハザード専用ザクＩＩを 1/100スケールＭＧシリーズで商品化。
ＭＳＶ機体独特なカラーとマーキングを、成形色と水転写デカールで再現！
● パーソナルカラーでカラーリングされた機体を成形色で徹底再現！
ギャビー・ハザードのパーソナルカラーとされる茶色と黒の機体を、成形色の色分けで再現。
● ＭＳＶ特有のマーキング類を水転写デカールで再現！
ＭＳＶ機体独特なラインなどのマークを含んだマーキングが、位置合わせがしやすい水転写デカールで付属。
● ポージングの幅が広がる豊富な武器付属
付属武装 ： ジャイアント・バズーカ ／ ザク・バズーカ ／ ザク・マシンガン ／ ヒート・ホーク
１／１００スケール組み立て式プラモデル

en: A highly maneuverable Zaku with distinctive coloring and MSV-specific markings. MSV series aircraft, MG kits are being made one after another!
Lieutenant Colonel Gabby Hazard appears on the battlefield --------------------
From Mobile Suit Gundam MSV, MS-06R-2 Gabby Hazard's Zaku II is commercialized in the 1/100 Scale MG series.
The unique colors and markings of the MSV aircraft are reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals!
● Thoroughly reproduce the aircraft colored in your personal color with molded colors!
The brown and black fuselage, which is Gabby Hazard's personal color, is reproduced by color-coding the molding colors.
● Reproduce MSV-specific markings with water transfer decals!
Markings that include marks such as lines unique to the MSV aircraft are included as water transfer decals that are easy to align.
● Comes with a variety of weapons that expand the range of poses
Attached weapons: Giant Bazooka / Zaku Bazooka / Zaku Machine Gun / Heat Hawk
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE/ABS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
